Package com.wualabs.qtsurfer.engine.indicators.momentum.pro

package com.wualabs.qtsurfer.engine.indicators.momentum.pro
Pro momentum / oscillator indicators (pro tier).

Oscillators: Accelerator, Awesome, Balance of Power, CMO, Connors RSI, Coppock, DPO, Fisher transforms, KST, Momentum, RVI, ROC, Stochastic, TRIX, TSI, Ultimate, Williams %R. Part of the paid pro indicator library — server-private, not shipped in the OSS/TypeScript build. The pro package segment is the tier marker.
